Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The following Terms & Conditions has to be accepted for supplying 6000 SBT SHS gunny bags with- (i) 5500 bags for FSD OJM, Budge Budge, West Bengal-700138 and (ii) 500 bags for FSD Ashok nagar, Kachua More, North 24 Parganas, West Bengal- 743222 through GeM Bid floated by this offi ce. This is in addition to the Terms & Condition of GeM. ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. The weight of each SHS SBT jute gunny should be 580 g with allowable tolerance limit of +8% and -6%. The dimensions of the SHS jute gunny should be 94 cm in length and 57 c m in width, with tolerances of +4 cm and -0 cm for both parameters. Parameter Values Range The weight of each SHS jute gunny580 g with allowable tolerance limit of +8% and -6% 545-626 g . Length of each SHS jute gunny 94 cm with tolerances of +4 cm and -0 cm 94-98 cm Width of each SHS jute gunny 57 cm with tolerances of +4 cm and -0 cm 57-61 cm

2. The jute gunny bags shall be free from patches, holes and foreign materials, mildews / fungal grow th, cuts, wears and tears, sun-fading. 3. The top of the bag shall be left open and top edge of the sacking cloth also shall be stitched separa tely on the selvedge if required. 4. Empty jute gunnies to be supplied should be one-time used and should be of good quality and sh ould not have been used earlier for strong toxic materials such as fertilizers, construction materials, cement etc. which are not fit for human consumption. 5. Grains (food grains) should not bleed out of the gunnies in filled condition and the same should be i ntact. 6. Option clause: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves th e right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. 7. The Successful party should deliver the SHS gunny bags as per the specifications/parameters. The s upplied material will be checked at the time of delivery by the concerned depot manager towards a scertaining the quality and quantity of the same and will be accepted only after the quality specifica tions and quantity are met. 8. Delivery should be completed within stipulated time. 9. Invoice against supply and delivery of goods should be forwarded along with proof of successful deli very at the depot. 10. Payment will be made after successful completion of entire delivery of accepted quality product. 11. The supplier should quote the rate/bid including all taxes, goods & service tax, packing/delivery cha rges, insurance charges, freight, handling charges, all other ancillary charges, on Destination basis f or delivery. 12. In case of the supplied once used gunny were found to be defective, then the supplier will arrange t o take back the defective goods at his own cost and expenses and replace same with sound items. F CI will not be responsible for the expenses incurred by the supplier due to return of the defective go ods. 13. Divisional Manager-DO 24 Parganas reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the tenders with out assigning any reason(s) whatsoever. 14. The bidders are advised to submit the following documents :- (1) PAN Card (self-attested) (2) GST registration certificate (3) Trade license (4) MSME registration certificate (if applicable) .
